## What's changed

- Added a custom Tater Bumper library with multi-file uploads, rotation management, and automatic restoration of the built-in bumpers when the custom library is emptied.
- Added clear per-channel controls for no commercials, no bumpers, Tater bumpers only, or selected bumper groups, including bumper-only channel breaks.
- Fixed standalone Tater Bumper playback on Apple TV by serving required transcodes through buffered, range-capable HLS segments instead of an open-ended progressive response.
- Refined the Tater Bumpers and Tube TV configuration interfaces so the expanded controls remain compact, readable, and contained at narrower desktop widths.
